messages.author: dfa9061eb984ddd2
messages.subject: RJDBC library crashing shiny server
parts:
I am running SuSE SLES12 SP2 and have installed all dependencies correctly as far as I can tell. I can sudo -u shiny R and execute library(RJDBC) and run my SQL commands with no problem. However, when deployed on my local shiny server, I get a "Disconnected from the server. Reload" message straight away. It appears to be simply related to that library(RJDBC) command. Unfortunately, shiny does not even generate a log file: nothing in /var/log/shiny-server/log and I get a "Diagnostic information is private. Please ask your system admin for permission if you need to check the R logs." in my chrome console despite my having added options(shiny.sanitize.errors = FALSE) to my application.

I suspect some kind of permission issue but it's strange that my R console would execute everything properly as user shiny.

Any insight or hint as to where to look next is appreciated.

messages.author: dfa9061eb984ddd2
messages.subject: Re: RJDBC library crashing shiny server
parts:
I seem to have gotten a bit closer. 

1) create a password for user shiny: sudo passwd shiny
1.5) as user shiny, I cannot load library(RJDBC) (the problem appears to be rJava)
2) as shiny, I run the following two bash commands:
R CMD javareconf -e
LD_LIBRARY_PATH=$LD_LIBRARY_PATH:$JAVA_LD_LIBRARY_PATH
3) still as user shiny, I can now run R and load library(RJDBC)

My problem is that I'm not sure how to make that change permanent for user shiny (I think it's likely a basic linux question at this point).
